inferenceContract.negativePromptSemantics: Official predict applies positive token thresholds. A sentence containing not/reflection is not an implemented negative-concept competition API.

trainingAndLabels.trainingCodeInPinnedRepo: README training-code TODO remains unchecked. Do not promise turnkey finetuning from this repository.
trainingAndLabels.annotationUse: Produces bbox+phrase proposals. Reviewed full boxes/classes can train the existing small detector; no pixel masks are produced by GroundingDINO itself.
trainingAndLabels.zeroAnnotationClaim: Pretrained open-set inference needs no user boxes, but target-domain accuracy/absence rejection still need labeled validation.

negativeAndMixedSceneLimits: Language specifies the intended class in mixed scenes; it does not establish reliable counting of novel parts such as skewer tips or pipe openings.
A fixed box/text similarity threshold is not a verified absence detector for glare, condensation or empty dishes.
900queries and800/1333resize can limit dense tiny-object counting; generic object boxes may cover an entire bundle rather than each endpoint.

runtime.CPU: Official non-CUDA path calls pure-PyTorch multi_scale_deformable_attn_pytorch; setup returns no extension when CUDA unavailable.
runtime.MPS: Static non-CUDA branch can select PyTorch grid_sample path, but end-to-end MPS/numerical/operation support was not tested.
runtime.CUDA: Uses compiled groundingdino._C when CUDA tensor path selected. Missing _C can still fail on CUDA despite import warning.
runtime.mobile: Hundreds-of-MB checkpoints plus text encoder and deformable attention; no CoreML/iPhone acceptance. Prefer an offline teacher.

inferenceContract.baseModelOutput: Class token + patch tokens; optional4register tokens; patch14.
inferenceContract.optionalTextExtension: dino.txt is a separate ViT-L/14-register+vision/text-head route for image/pixel language alignment; it still does not supply an instance counter.

trainingAndLabels.pretraining: Self-supervised image crops require no human annotations; original large-scale training is a distributed GPU/xFormers/FSDP workflow, not a small current-dataset recipe.
trainingAndLabels.downstream: Crop positive/negative labels for a feature verifier; point/density or complete bbox labels for a counting/detection head; reviewed masks only if training segmentation.
trainingAndLabels.proposedUse: Keep features frozen first. Use reviewed training-only colony/glare/print/bubble crops to inspect separability and mine disagreements, not unreviewed pseudo-labels.

runtime.publicBackboneWeights: Anonymous official dl.fbaipublicfiles URLs exist for standard DINOv2. No weights fetched this round.
runtime.CPU: MemEffAttention falls back to torch scaled_dot_product_attention if xFormers disabled/unavailable and no attention bias.
runtime.MPS: Potential for plain single-tensor feature extraction after device placement; unverified here. Nested-list training path requires xFormers.
runtime.environment: Pinned attention.py includes float|None type annotations without postponed evaluation; current project Python3.9 environment is not a safe drop-in target. Use a separate supported environment in a future authorized probe.
runtime.mobile: ViT-S21M≈42MB fp16 parameter-only estimate, excluding heads/activations. Even smallest backbone is much larger than current tiny detector; CoreML conversion/latency unknown.

risks: Patch14 resolution can erase very small endpoints/colonies; dense features need crop/scale evaluation.
Feature similarity is not a probability of biological growth or proof of zero objects.
Cell-DINO is fluorescence-microscopy embedding code; do not substitute it for macroscopic Petri-dish colony counting merely because its name contains Cell.

inferenceContract.externalExamples: Reviewed exemplar banks from other TRAIN images can be reused across photos, avoiding per-photo user boxes.
inferenceContract.filter: Keep a query only if positive similarity exceeds confidence threshold AND exceeds every negative similarity. Use structured positive/negative concepts, not merely natural-language not.
inferenceContract.pseudoExamples: Predicted high-score boxes can be fed back automatically; potential error amplification must be tested on glare and minority target morphology.
inferenceContract.demoVsPaper: README explicitly says Gradio demo omits pseudo-exemplars and adaptive cropping. Published text-only FSCD command uses synthetic+pseudo exemplars and crop; do not assign full paper scores to demo.

trainingAndLabels.labels: All target-instance centers and class/text labels; few exemplar boxes add weak width/height/GIoU supervision. Multiple class mosaics allow competing concept supervision; masks not required.
trainingAndLabels.packageSource: OfficialREADME external trainingZIP; selectiveHTTPRange extraction only, no model weights downloaded.
trainingAndLabels.trainingRecipeInArchive: train.sh→config/countgd_box_a.py:30epochs,batch4,900queries,frozenSwin/BERT,classification2,center/size5,GIoU2. This is not a recommendation to repeat it on our small set.
trainingAndLabels.zeroTargetHandling: Training engine explicitly handles zero exemplar sets; criterion clamps num_boxes at1. All-empty GT batches and new distractor schemas still need future finite-loss/gradient tests before adaptation.
trainingAndLabels.hardNegativeAdaptation: To teach explicit glare/bubble/print concepts, curate reviewed distractor regions/classes as well as full-image target-absent plates. Do not assume generic FSC mosaics already cover colony glare.

runtime.architecture: Swin-B+bert-base-uncased,800/1333resize,900queries; external images and pseudo-exemplar iterations add passes.
runtime.CUDA: Customattention always callsMSDeformAttnFunction; extension setup raises when CUDA absent. A CPU-selection helper in process_folder does not make whole model CPU/MPS-ready.
runtime.paperExtraCost: README reproduction uses precomputed synthetic exemplars and super-resolution crops; it states the cited super-resolution service is not free. No paid service or image generation was used here.
runtime.mobile: Offline only at present. No locally measured runtime, memory, or CoreML success.

paperSpecificEvidence.brief: Author method combines center labels, exemplar box geometry and contrastive class prompts. Training adds1000multi-class mosaics; image/text encoders stay frozen. Pseudo-exemplars remove per-image manual boxes, but text still specifies target.

criticalSourceFindings: For zero-shot without text, clusters with frequency >50% of largest cluster are retained; rare genuine colony morphologies can be discarded.
When verification feature count exceeds500, forward returns generated detections/density without clustering verification. Dense-case false-positive removal therefore is not uniform.
Text cluster acceptance is relative to maxCLIPscore×0.85; this is not a validated absolute target-absence detector.
Density-map resizing divides by map sum; zero-density negative-image adaptation needs explicit safe handling.

runtime.backbone: ResNet50 withdensity/detectionheads plus verification weights; optional largeCLIP encoder.
runtime.graph: ROIAlign, NumPy/scikit-learn spectral clustering, CPU transfer and sometimes two-pass resize. No self-contained CoreML/iPhone evidence.
